decisions.reason: This inertial measurement sensor module remains tightly aligned with our existing sensing hardware, firmware and software stack, so accumulated user feedback can be absorbed efficiently and turned into incremental improvements rather than a withdrawal.
The industrial AC voltage input module sits squarely within our established measurement and automation competence base, making it a highly supportable platform extension with low absorptive risk.
The four-channel solid state relay module is strongly complementary to our control architecture and manufacturing know-how, so it is more valuable to refine within the platform than to discontinue.

The RGB LED control module builds on our modular electronics, APIs and event-driven logic and is close enough to our knowledge base that we can learn from early demand without major strain on development resources.

The remote access service for wallboxes fits our strategic expansion in charging and energy management, but as a newer service-heavy offer it carries somewhat higher execution and support uncertainty even though our software and charging knowledge make continued development worthwhile.
